_comment: Source of truth for Wren's App Analytics campaign tokens. Never type a token
by hand: run `python store/campaign_links.py` and copy what it prints.
'IG-Organic-Gone-By-Thursday' become two rows that will never be merged, and
one typo silently mints a third. That is the whole reason this file exists.
providerToken is NOT invented. Apple generates it when the first campaign
link is created in App Store Connect (Analytics > Acquisition > Campaigns >
+), and it is the same value for every campaign afterwards. Until it is
filled in here the generator refuses to print links, because a link missing
pt= is accepted by the App Store and attributed to nothing.
One token per CREATIVE, not per post. A token per post fragments the volume

campaigns.notes: Reels and stories. One token for the creative across every post of it.
Same creative, different channel, so a separate token.

campaigns.creative: The App Store badge and text link on the Apps page
campaigns.notes: Separate from site-wren-hero. Somebody who reached the Apps page went looking; somebody who clicked the hero was offered. Those are different intents and worth telling apart.
